exposure: Initiation of citalopram while on hydrocodone
Initiation of escitalopram while on hydrocodone
Initiation of fluoxetine while on hydrocodone
Initiation of paroxetine while on hydrocodone
Initiation of sertraline while on hydrocodone
outcome: Emergency department visit due to opioid overdose
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1,486,583 patients from US public and commercial health insurance claims data who initiated a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, or sertraline) while receiving hydrocodone treatment.
finding: Initiating citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, or paroxetine while on hydrocodone was associated with an increased risk of opioid overdose compared with sertraline, but no substantial risk differences were observed among SSRIs other than sertraline.
